approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content, using the smallest open-source or standard-library solution.
notes: A synthetic offline reproduction grouped adjacent RFI Question and Submittal Approved evidence into one extraction batch.
Keep existing four-fragment and 8.8 KB batching for ordinary documents and matching workflow sections.
Use existing locator text and Python standard-library regular expressions; add no dependency or new framework.
Do not infer workflow relationships, authority or approval precedence.
The shared adjacency check now isolates different RFI IDs/roles, Submittal IDs/statuses, RFI/Submittal families and workflow-to-ordinary transitions while preserving same-scope and ordinary batching.
642 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline with 105 requirements, 15 schemas and a 362-file bundle manifest; no external or paid call was made.
title: Isolate workflow extraction batches
objective: Prevent physically adjacent evidence from different explicit RFI or Submittal workflow sections from sharing one extraction prompt while preserving bounded batching inside the same section and for non-workflow documents.
